title: Airline Travel Reviews Data (Skytrax)
license: CC BY 4.0 as stated by the repository
collection: The depositors identify Skytrax passenger reviews as the source and document removing passenger names and some other fields. No respondent identity or verified-flight audit was performed.
geography: International, not a Philippine-only survey; international data explicitly authorized by the user.
target: Original self-reported recommended yes/no, not a satisfaction label reconstructed from overall rating.
record_unit: One public airline review, not necessarily one unique passenger or independently verified flight.
rating_scale: 1 to 5; missing or out-of-range values are imputed using training data only.
split: Training reviews before 2023-01-01; held-out reviews from 2023-01-01 onward.
limitations: Post-flight recommendation classification, not pre-flight satisfaction forecasting.
Opt-in online reviews may not represent all passengers.
Repeat reviewers cannot be identified because passenger identities are absent.
International historical results do not establish performance for Philippine airlines or current 2026 operations.
